quests.desc: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to head east. Then, try to head east. Then, make an effort to move south. Following that, venture south. With that over with, move east. If you can get around to doing that, head south. Okay, and then, make an effort to move west. And then, travel south. After that, head west. Once you do that, try to take a trip west. That done, go to the north. With that over with, head east. And then, take a trip north. Okay, and then, make an attempt to travel north. Then, try to venture west. With that accomplished, lift the American style keycard from the floor of the bedchamber. And then, make an effort to take a trip west. And then, make absolutely sure that the American style chest is unlocked. Then, ensure that the American style chest is open. Then, pick up the broom from the American style chest. That's it!

objective: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First off, take a trip east. And then, go to the east. After that, make an effort to travel south. After that, make an attempt to go south. Then, go east. That done, go to the south. Then, head west. After that, take a trip south. That done, make an attempt to venture west. And then, venture west. Then, make an effort to head north. After that, venture east. And then, try to travel north. Then, go north. Next, attempt to go west. And then, lift the American style keycard from the floor of the bedchamber. With the American style keycard, make an effort to go to the west. With that over with, insert the American style keycard into the American style chest within the sauna's lock to unlock it. After that, make sure that the American style chest in the sauna is wide open. After that, retrieve the broom from the American style chest within the sauna. Got that? Good!
